description: Not a lever of the fused stack: exact resume P0 (QWEN_PREFIX_STICKY_UNDROP + QWEN_PREFIX_WINDOW_CARRY, the ER package) carried onto the ship-4 + Swift stack and made to work beside its tile-aligned drafter window (the carried rows join the aligned join as its first part, prefix_window_carry.Carried.align), with the analysis of why nothing finer than the 2048 grid can be byte-exact today (docs/tp4-exact-end.md), the arithmetic model and the chunk-grid proof (exact_end_model.py), the attribution arms of the split probe (tp4_split_probe.py --attribute, C2_FABRIC_PROBE=split-attribute) and the prefix gate's Swift checkpoint (c2_prefix_gate.py --model-repo/--model-revision). Its two gate-only twins (-fx-s4-xe and -fx-s4-xe-audit of the approved ship-4 profile) are generated by make_xe_profiles.py; its window is references/fusion-jobs/XE (make_xe_jobs.py). Unset (the default) nothing moves.
notes: Shared files this package edits: dflash_prefill_window.py (a carried capture keeps the aligned join), prefix_window_carry.py (Carried.align), tp4_split_probe.py (--attribute), c2_prefix_gate.py (--model-repo/--model-revision, judge_arm reads the checkpoint lines), c2_serving_job.py (prefix joins the actions that forward the checkpoint; the split-attribute probe), qwen-c2-serving.yml (the prefix step forwards the pair; the split-attribute case), test_exact_resume.py (the switches-off comparison is against the swift graft), and the census tests that exempt generated twins. Every change is off unless an exact-resume switch, --attribute or a checkpoint pair is named.
